AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
